title: Peer Review: WDD Genesis Block Audit
description: The VC has dropped the vomit prompt and Agent Smith has scaffolded the Genesis Block in `docs/HOLEMAP.md`. You are the Auditor. Review the scaffolding. Identify missing architectural pieces, security gaps, or logical impossibilities in the planned self-construction of WDD.

requirements.audit_scope: Read `docs/HOLEMAP.md`. Ensure that the sequence of workorders makes logical sense for a self-building compiler.
requirements.hole_map_expansion: If steps are missing (e.g., how the replay benchmark is invoked, or how schemas are validated), ADD the missing workorders to the HOLE MAP.
requirements.report: Generate `docs/AUDIT_REPORT.md` documenting your findings and the additions you made to the Hole Map.

acceptance_criteria: HOLEMAP.md is expanded to include all necessary execution steps.
failure_modes: FAIL: Approving the plan blindly without identifying missing plumbing.
